Alex (Support): Heads-up: AcmeMaps reported a p99 jump after yesterday's quant calibration rollout. They saw p95 ~220ms -> 420ms and p99 ~480ms -> 1.2s on chat/complete calls
Maria (SRE): Yikes. Customer ID 9983? which model variant did we push?
Alex (Support): Yep 9983. Model = redwood-7b-int8-calib-v3, region us-west-2, traffic routed to dedicated pool. They triggered after a normal traffic spike (~12k reqs/min).
Jin (Eng Runtime): Can you paste a sample request and the minimal repro?
Alex (Support): Repro payload (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-7b-int8-calib-v3",
  "input": "Summarize the route: ...",
  "max_tokens": 256,
  "stream": false
}
```
Observed latencies in request logs (us-west-2, last 15m):
- baseline (pre-calib): p50 70ms, p95 220ms, p99 480ms
- after calib: p50 75ms, p95 420ms, p99 1.2s
Maria (SRE): Interesting that p50 barely changed. Sounds like a tail kernel or per-layer slow path under certain sequence lengths / KV cache patterns.
Caleb (ML): Calibration can alter quant kernels (per-layer scale/zero-point) which may enable slower fallback paths or trigger suboptimal kernel selection. Does runtime log kernel selection?
Jin (Eng Runtime): We emit kernel tags at debug level. Can you turn on debug for that customer's route for 30m and collect the logs? Quick command: 
```bash
redwoodctl route update --customer 9983 --debug true --duration 30m
```
Alex (Support): Running that now. Meanwhile, any immediate mitigation we can apply for the customer? They want a quick rollback or workaround.
Caleb (ML): Two quick options: 1) rollback to previous calibration profile (v2) which was int8 but different scales, or 2) enforce fallback to fp16 for that customer until we root-cause. FP16 will increase cost but fix latency.
Maria (SRE): For speed, we can add a routing rule to use redwood-7b-fp16 for customer 9983. Jin, can you apply and confirm how to do that safely?
Jin (Eng Runtime): Yes. Minimal change via control plane: update routing policy. Example PATCH request to control plane: 
```json
PATCH /v1/routing/policies/9983
{ "priority": 10, "match": {"customer_id": "9983"}, "route": {"model": "redwood-7b-fp16", "fallback": "none"}}
```
I can push a canary to 100% for that customer only. Doing it in 2 min.
DeployBot: scheduling rollout of routing policy PATCH for customer 9983 -> redwood-7b-fp16 (canary 100%) by Jin at 2320012450
Maria (SRE): After that, keep debug on for 30m and collect tail traces. Also capture per-request kernel tags and quant branch timestamps.
Alex (Support): Noted. Customer notified of temporary switch to fp16. They'll validate UX.
Caleb (ML): Post-mitigation root-cause plan:
- collect kernel tags + per-layer timings from debug logs
- compare calib-v3 scales vs calib-v2, look for quantized layers with high dynamic range
- run internal perf bench with same input distribution (seq len distribution matching AcmeMaps)
- if calibration introduced pathological scale pairs, recompute profile (or apply per-layer clamp)
Jin (Eng Runtime): Also check kernel selection heuristics: some int8 kernels fall back to a reference path for certain tile sizes. We might tweak the kernel selector thresholds as a short-term patch.
Maria (SRE): Agreed. For immediate action: Jin, apply routing policy now. Caleb, start the calibration diff analysis. Alex, keep customer comms. I'll watch metrics/dashboards for p95/p99.
Jin (Eng Runtime): Applied. Route updated at 2320012460. Customer now on fp16 variant.
DeployBot: rollout complete for customer 9983 at 2320012460
Alex (Support): Customer reports latency dropped back to normal within 2 minutes: p95 ~210ms, p99 ~490ms. They :thumbsup:.
Maria (SRE): Good. Keep fp16 until we have a vetted recalibration. Caleb, do you want a canary job to test recalib v3' with tweaks?
Caleb (ML): Yes. I'll run a targeted recalibration using AcmeMaps' seq-length histogram and disable aggressive per-channel scaling. Will post results in ~2 hours.
Jin (Eng Runtime): After Caleb posts, we'll do a staged rollout: canary 1% -> 10% -> 50% with metrics gates on p95/p99 and kernel fallback counters.
Alex (Support): Filing a follow-up ticket and sharing runbook with the customer:
- temporary mitigation: route to fp16 variant
- repro steps + log collection cmd
- expected timeline: final fix after calib rework or kernel selector tweak
Maria (SRE): Thanks. Action items:
- Alex: customer comms + ticket 45782 (assigned)
- Jin: keep debug logs for 30m, monitor dashboards, rollback routing if anything odd
- Caleb: calibration diff + bench, post artifacts
- Maria: monitor and coordinate postmortem if needed

Alex (Support): Adding notes to the ticket, linking logs: https://redwood-internal/logs/trace/2320012500 (internal)
Caleb (ML): Preliminary diff shows 3 layers with >2x scale change vs v2. Running perf bench now.
Maria (SRE): Great. If perf bench reproduces tail, we'll either tweak selector thresholds or pin those layers to a safer quant (mixed precision) until we can recalibrate.
Alex (Support): Customer will stay on fp16 for now. They appreciated the quick action. :+1:
Jin (Eng Runtime): Closing the immediate escalation. Will update ticket 45782 with timeline for canary rollout.
DeployBot: debug logging auto-disabled at 2320012720
Maria (SRE): Thanks team. We'll regroup when Caleb has bench results. :eyes:
